title: Which NBA team will sign Trey Alexander to a two-way contract in the first two weeks of July 2026?
background: A two-way contract allows a player to play for both an NBA team and its G League affiliate.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: as confirmed by a team announcement or contemporaneous sports reporting
  • Resolution Date: Resolve to the NBA team that signs Trey Alexander to a two-way contract between July 1 and July 14, 2026, inclusive
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the team's full name.

title: Which ownership group will receive NFL owners' approval to buy the Seattle Seahawks in 2026?
background: The Seattle Seahawks are owned by Paul Allen's estate. Allen's will calls for the team to be sold and the assets distributed to charities.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official NFL announcement or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the purchasing group approved by NFL owners.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the purchasing ownership group in the first sale of the Seattle Seahawks formally approved by NFL owners during 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the purchasing group or the family leading it.

title: Who will win the Most Valuable Player award at the 2026 MLB All-Star Game?
background: The MLB All-Star Game is an annual exhibition between the American League and National League. Its Most Valuable Player award recognizes an individual player's performance in the game.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: MLB's official announcement of the 2026 All-Star Game MVP, corroborated by contemporaneous reputable news reporting.
  • Resolution Timing: The question resolves when the MVP recipient is publicly announced following the 2026 All-Star Game, expected in July 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the player awarded the game's MVP honor.

title: Which NBA team will LeBron James choose for the 2026–27 season?
background: This question concerns James's publicly announced team choice for the upcoming NBA season.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: James's public announcement of his team choice for the 2026–27 season during the 2026 offseason, corroborated by reputable news or sports reporting.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve when James publicly announces that choice. A completed contract signing or appearance in a game is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the NBA team he chooses.

title: If the Detroit Tigers trade Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline, which team will acquire him?
background: Tarik Skubal is a starting pitcher for the Detroit Tigers and is eligible for free agency after the 2026 season.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official MLB or team announcements, or confirmed reporting from ESPN, identifying a completed trade of Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the MLB club acquiring Skubal directly from the Detroit Tigers. If no such trade occurs by the deadline, the question is void.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The acquiring club's full team name.

title: Who will win the 2026 Rocket Classic on the PGA Tour?
background: The Rocket Classic is a men's professional golf tournament on the PGA Tour.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The PGA Tour's official final results for the 2026 Rocket Classic.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the golfer officially declared the tournament winner following the final round and any playoff required to determine the champion.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning golfer's full name.

title: Who will win the 2026 St Jude Championship on the PGA Tour?
background: The St Jude Championship is the opening tournament of the PGA Tour's FedEx Cup playoffs.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The PGA Tour's official final results for the 2026 St Jude Championship.
  • Resolution: The question resolves when the tournament concludes and its champion is officially determined, including any playoff if required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning golfer's full name.

title: Who will leave UFC 330 as the UFC women's strawweight champion?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UFC's official event results and championship recognition, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the fighter recognized as the undisputed UFC women's strawweight champion immediately after the division's title bout at UFC 330. Use the fight-night outcome, excluding subsequent title changes or reversals.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The champion's full name.

title: Who will win the welterweight championship main event at UFC 330?
resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution: Resolve to the fighter officially declared the winner of the welterweight championship main event at UFC 330. Use the result announced on fight night, excluding any subsequent reversal.

title: Which club will lead Major League Soccer's Eastern Conference at the end of play on August 19, 2026?
resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-19 (after all matches dated August 19, 2026)
  • Accepted Answer Format: The club's name

title: What will be the furthest stage Inter Miami reaches in the 2026 Leagues Cup?
background: The Leagues Cup features clubs from Major League Soccer and Mexico’s Liga MX. Inter Miami won the tournament in 2023 and finished as runners-up in 2025.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Leagues Cup results or reliable contemporaneous match reports covering Inter Miami’s participation in the 2026 tournament.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve once Inter Miami is eliminated or completes the tournament final. The answer is the furthest tournament stage in which the club plays.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide only the name of the tournament stage.

title: Which UEFA competition's league phase will Celtic enter in the 2026–27 season?
background: Celtic are seeking a place in the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League through the qualifying playoffs.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official qualification results, corroborated by contemporaneous match reporting.
  • Resolution Rule: Resolve to the European competition whose league phase Celtic qualify for following the completion of their August 2026 Champions League qualifying-playoff tie.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The competition's standard name.

title: Which club, if any, will win the La Liga Madrid derby on September 20, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official La Liga match result, corroborated by reliable news coverage.
  • Resolution: Resolve according to the final score, including stoppage time, of the Madrid derby scheduled for September 20, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.

title: Which club will win the 2026 Campeones Cup?
background: The Campeones Cup is an annual match between the previous season’s MLS Cup champion and the winner of Mexico’s Campeón de Campeones.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official competition result published by Major League Soccer, supported by reliable match reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the club officially declared the winner of the 2026 Campeones Cup once the match has concluded, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club’s name.

title: Who will score the match-winning goal in Portugal's opening fixture of the 2026–27 UEFA Nations League?
background: Portugal enter the competition as defending champions. This question concerns their senior men's team's first league-phase match.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official match report or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera Sport.
  • Resolution: Resolve after Portugal's opening league-phase match in September 2026. The match-winning goal is the winning team's goal that brings its total to one more than the losing team's final total. The answer is the player officially credited with that goal, regardless of which team wins.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The goalscorer's full name. If the match ends in a draw, return “No winning scorer”.

title: Who will win Nottingham Forest's opening Premier League match of the 2026–27 season?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official Premier League result for Nottingham Forest's first league fixture of the 2026–27 season.
  • Resolution: Resolve according to the result at full time, including stoppage time. Preseason and cup fixtures do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name, or “Draw” if the match finishes level.
